scope: Exact passing consent/preparation cancellation after locality loss
finding: Passing metadata release also required current vehicle locality. DrivingOperationFinish only reached ordinary pass cleanup behind its native locality guard. Thus old-owner consent/preparation could remain after authority ended, while existing passive agreements timed out.
implementation: Passing release validates the original captured vehicle owner and exact private receipt independently of current vehicle locality. Finish cancels preparation by exact brain/epoch/generation, then retires pending, active and passive consent by both captured crew group/epoch/generation receipts. Passive consent does not require active pass work. The actor schema appends generation at index10; the broker compares it. The whole private release/CANCEL transaction is unscheduled for scheduled direct callers. Successor receipts survive. Native work/public leg provenance remains for current-owner cleanup; no native command or cap replay is issued.
serverBoundary: DrivingPassAgreementServer RELEASE validates sender in original accepted owners before retiring token. Current ownership need not persist to withdraw consent; withdrawal grants no execution authority.
cost: Constant per-tracked-vehicle private metadata checks on existing finish/cancel paths. No scan, new timer/worker, baseline transport or native cap reapplication.

validation.fullPipeline: 1476 existing tests, compiler/FSM/config/documentation/parity/performance gates and sealed unsigned development package passed.

limits: Live owner transfer, successor/preparation race, deleted/untracked vehicle and packet ordering remain acceptance items. No completed queue movement or external-provider handover claim.
ownerIdentity: Pass and queue contexts use DrivingOwnerReceipt: actual private epoch/generation for local groups; existing sparse six-field public driving status stamped with actual group owner for remote groups. Missing/old/wrong-owner status returns an unavailable whole context. The actual owner still verifies full context and live FSM before consent. No additional publication cadence, worker or scan.
